messages:
Maya (CSM): Kicking off Pelorus Pharma onboarding — customer signed Redwood Private (VPC). Pilot target 6 weeks. Primary asks: SSO (SCIM), EU data residency, HSM proof-of-concept, and throughput for batch inference. Need owners and risks.

Luca (Customer PM): Pelorus stakeholders: Elena (CTO), Marco (Infra), Dr. Sato (ML lead), Imogen (Compliance). They prefer Tues morning checkpoints and a day-28 pilot review.

Dev (Solutions): Proposing perf goals: p95 token latency < 160ms for 1k context; embedding batch throughput >= 250 qps. Will run emulation after staging.

Anya (Onboard Eng): I'll own VPC peering, staging cluster, smoke tests. Need Marco's CIDR and VPN cert. Timeline: peering day 2, staging day 6.

Rafael (Security): Compliance: 12-month log retention and DPA signed before prod. BYOK via Azure Key Vault ok; external HSM will add 3 business days. Flagging DPA/SOC2 as renewal risk if delayed.

Bea (Enablement): I'll prepare two sessions: Intro + Ops. They want CET timezone. I'll record and add to customer library.

Maya (CSM): Actions added to playbook: Anya network/staging (due day 3); Dev perf plan (due day 7); Rafael compliance/KMS (due day 5); Bea enablement (due day 4); Luca stakeholder invites (due day 1). Link: https://docs.redwood.example/s/Pelorus-onboard

Luca (Customer PM): Invited Elena, Marco, Dr. Sato, Imogen to first sync Tue 09:00 CET. Marco posted CIDR in doc.

Anya (Onboard Eng): Network snippet pasted to playbook. Will open peering ticket now.

Rafael (Security): Legal pulled SOC2 excerpt and uploaded. DPA draft requested by Pelorus procurement for next Tue.

Maya (CSM): Great — meeting scheduled, owners assigned, playbook link shared. Tag blockers #onboard-blockers. Closing kickoff and moving to weekly status updates.

calendar-bot: Created event "Pelorus onboarding - kickoff" at 2123460000 (Tue 09:00 CET) with guests: Maya, Luca, Bea, Elena, Marco, Dr. Sato.
